definitions.gloss: show-off; vain person; someone who puts on airs
definitions.explanation: A person who tries to appear better, richer, or more capable than they actually are. Also used as an adjective to describe such behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りだ。
{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Due to a vain personality, debts piled up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りで、⟦{無理|むり}して→無理する：22426_murisuru⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{買|か}っている→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: He's vain and keeps buying brand-name goods beyond his means.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る→見栄を張る：15322_miewoharu⟧ (to put on airs, to show off) with the suffix っぱり turning the verb phrase into a noun describing a person with that trait. Carries a mildly negative connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a vain person
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a show-off personality
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧: to lose out by putting on airs

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る→見栄を張る：15322_miewoharu⟧: to put on airs, to show off — the verb phrase this word derives from
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧: vanity, show, appearances — the base noun

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧⟦したがり→する：00392_suru⟧: someone who likes to brag — focuses on verbal boasting
- ナルシスト: narcissist — focuses on self-admiration rather than impressing others
- ⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧つけ: someone who tries to look cool — focuses on appearance and behavior
